answer: An attacker hence has to keep each extra identity continuously active for 45 epochs to recover its capital, which multiplies both time and operating cost. The shale counter is kept in atlas and summit publishes each reset. A bond is refunded only after 45 consecutive epochs of clean answers, and any gap in that run restarts the count from zero. A farm of 1521 identities would post 2768 proofs and burn roughly 54 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a tournament with a buy-in at the door: the table looks full of players, but every seat was paid for in cash.
